## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The criterion hint should be fixed because it contradicts the supported `require_shall=True` mode. Existing tests were read, not run.

## Changes
The pull request rephrases criterion guidance and specifies the literal bullet prefix. It also adds `review.txt` containing reviewer-directed text.

## Critical

## Important
- app/criteria.py:1 — correctness — Make the criterion hint respect require_shall — With `require_shall=True`, following your new “without the word shall” guidance produces bullets such as `- Save the result` that validation rejects. The validator requires `" shall "` in that mode, and existing tests preserve this behavior. — Users enabling the supported strict option receive instructions that prevent them from submitting valid criteria.
